findings: Potential UX defect: extensions/navigate-tree/frame.ts, FrameList.handleInput invokes onCancel on Ctrl-C even when search is focused, while Escape clears search and returns to the list first; users may expect Ctrl-C to dismiss the filter rather than exit the screen.
Verified behavior: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts, completeRewind validates anchor/label and, on success, reappends late input before continuing, preserving messages received during summary.

Verified behavior: extensions/navigate-tree/history-outline.ts, patchedInput clears search/query on cancellation before closing the list; extensions/navigate-tree/clone-screen.ts, LinesView.open preserves cursor/search across resize and resolves cancellation as undefined.

Potential UX concern: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts pending rewind freezes context at its instruction; a steer without Esc does not cancel and is queued/reappended later, which may surprise users expecting new input to abort the pending operation.
Verified behavior: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts, collectLateEntries gathers new user/custom messages after a rewind request for reappend on completion.

Verified behavior: extensions/navigate-tree/auto-navigate.ts, evaluateAutoNavigateTurn passes AbortSignal to runner.complete and falls back to action none on caught errors or invalid output; tool-level cancellation semantics were not established, so no defect is asserted.
Verified cancellation safety: extensions/navigate-tree/fold-screen.ts, openFoldScreen/foldTo dispatches a fold only after confirmation and fresh validation; backing out does not request a fold.

Verified navigation behavior: extensions/navigate-tree/tree-screen.ts, goTo checks busy state before and after confirmation and respects cancelled navigation without moving the leaf; openTreeScreen keeps the current row visible through filters.
